title: A live run moves on its own in grid steps and starts at Score 0
description: A run begins with the snake moving on its own in grid steps across the board and the score display reading exactly "Score 0".

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run (use the start control if there is one). Then watch the board without touching any key and look closely at how the snake moves and at the score display.
success: The snake was visibly moving on its own across the play area, without any key held
The snake moved in distinct grid steps rather than drifting freely
No error was shown and the board did not freeze
